cells.value: Inspection of the SRCG gun mount, pedestal assembly, pin ball, lock wire rope
DSS (for any salt contents) and functioning of locking handles.
Inspection of the electrical units, cameras, WNH1, WNH3 cable and LRF.
Inspection of humidity indicator plug for any moisture ingress.
Check lubrication on all moving parts, locking lever, exposed parts, sealants on all connectors and joints.
Check availability of power supply 230V/115V AC and indications available.
Switch on system and check system functionality of solenoid shot, cocking mechanism, firing pin and breech block assemblies. (Ensure Mount is empty)
Carry out BIT test of EMU and pedestal assembly.
Carry out functionality test of DSS, SCP, MFDU, cameras, LRF, Pod assembly.
Check the follow up of the system from SCP (gun should align with the POD) and verify electrical and mechanical limit.
Smooth operation of Training / Elevation drives.
Operability of Deck safety switch (DSS). When DSS / SAFE switch is inactive, verify that there is no ELV/TRV gun motion or ELV POD motion on MFDU.
Availability of desiccant bag and nitrogen purging kit.
Availability of authorised OBS Held on-board.
Sea and action and firing SOP
